failedAssertions.reason: Both picking_validation and outline_validation examples fail to compile due to API changes from robustness milestone (VAL-ROBUST-001 Result propagation, VAL-ROBUST-002 GpuAllocator wrapper) not reflected in example code. Specific issues: GpuAllocator no longer exposes borrow_mut() directly, begin_command_buffer() now returns Result instead of raw CommandBuffer, VulkanContext wrapped in Rc<Result<...>> which examples don't unwrap.

appliedUpdates.description: Added note: validation examples require --features validation flag
Added note: -s flag runs 100 frames, not 25 as documented in validation contract
